stem: Which of the following contributed most to the expansion of the transatlantic slave trade during the 1700s?

options.label: F
options.text: A lack of skilled labor in the American colonies

options.label: G
options.text: Demand for slaves in the American colonies that produced cash crops

options.label: H
options.text: A lack of protective tariffs in the American colonies

options.label: J
options.text: Demand for slaves in the industrialized American colonies
